title: Student V0.1 session delta provenance V2 R1
purpose: Qualify the minimum durable session provenance required to derive worked-during-session and state-changed-during-session semantics exactly before the R15 objective-progress UX restoration.
invariants: The learningLoopV2Session meta key is unchanged and new explicit learn/review sessions use schemaVersion 2.
The session baseline is captured once and remains immutable across answers, reload and resume.
Worked activities are derived only from persisted attempts greater than baseline attempts; no mutable worked list is authoritative.
Changed objective ids are derived only among worked objectives by qualified objective-state comparison.
updatedAt, clocks and estimated temporal boundaries are never used for session provenance.
Legacy schema v1 navigation remains resumable but its missing historical provenance is never invented.
Invalid schema v2 provenance fails closed for sessionDelta while preserving safe navigation fallback when possible.
NEXT_INDEXED_DB_NAME remains learnit_next_v1 and NEXT_INDEXED_DB_VERSION remains 2 with no new store or migration.
Parent PR #454 remains draft, open and unmerged.
No R15 learner-visible restoration or Human Replay occurs in this work package.
requiredEvidence: Session baseline objective states and activity-attempt counters are exact and immutable.
Multi-objective, repeated-attempt, non-scored and review-mode session delta cases pass.
Post-progress meta-write failure followed by runtime recreation preserves exact worked derivation.
Final activity returns final sessionDelta before normal cleanup.
Legacy v1 resume passes with unavailable-not-invented delta; invalid v2 provenance fails closed for delta.
Learning Loop V2 DEV and QA suites pass.
V4, V5 validator, V5 Factory/source governance, runtime V5, hints, references, feedback-media lifecycle, V8 presenters and exact 10-activity/39-minute showcase regressions pass.
ActivityResponse, scoring, objective-state, recommendation and V5 contract authorities remain byte-identical to the parent.
Deterministic build, source manifest and repository governance pass on the exact RESULT_SHA.
adversarialTests: Changing updatedAt without increasing attempts cannot mark an activity as worked.
Changing an objective projection without an attempts increase cannot place an unworked objective in changedObjectiveIds.
A failed learningLoopV2Session meta update after progress persistence cannot erase the worked fact after runtime recreation.
Malformed or incomplete v2 baseline maps do not get normalized or reconstructed.
A persisted mutable workedObjectiveIds list is absent.
nonGoals: Any scoring, progression or mastery model change.
V5 kit, source, Factory, semantic-review, presenter, hint, media or reference mutation.
Human Replay, merge, promotion or ATLAS-WP-054 closure.
independentReview: Qualification replays current Learning Loop V2 and cumulative R2 regression oracles rather than relying on JOB 19 reasoning.
Forbidden semantic-authority files are compared byte-exactly with the parent.
Repository governance is executed on the frozen RESULT_SHA before evidence-only closeout.
rollback: Close the unmerged JOB 20 pull request and delete student-v01/r2-session-delta-provenance-v2-r1; parent 8c7760e8230d0ecddc1998a47f1efc99822c7e99 and PR #454 remain unchanged.
